_comment: FR-4 superseded demotion. An active decision and its superseded predecessor share a subject; the predecessor's text carries `Status: superseded` exactly as buildNoteMemoryText projects it, state cold as the demotion floor leaves it. Locks the rendering half of the AC: the plain-topic fixture asserts the current decision wins top1 while the predecessor is reachable and labeled `(superseded)`, and the temporal fixture asserts an `old`/`history` query still reaches the predecessor's content. Scope of the gate, stated honestly: scenarios seed memory_items directly and never pass through insertNote, so the archived-vs-cold WRITE-path mapping is invisible here (the seeded state is taken as given) — that half is pinned by unit tests. What goes red without the feature is the `(superseded)` label needle, which the pre-1.4 renderer never emits. Timestamps are excluded from every needle because the scenario clock is generation-time. The two fixtures use different topics because findFixtureRegressions keys its baseline map on fixture.topic.
